scope.excluded: Workspace runs/ experiments were not inspected in this local-only audit.

source_assurance.source_snapshot_or_commit_hash: No matching source snapshot/commit hash was found in the 20 local result directories. experiment_manifest.json identifies source script for some fresh runs but does not identify an immutable source revision. The only nearby archived reward source is under analysis/scenario_revisions/darrl_r1_20260930/source and is a different DARRL r1 experiment, not evidence for these sorted runs.
source_assurance.consequence: Historical arguments and monitor outputs are direct run evidence. Formula branch order and implementation details below are confirmed in the currently present source, but cannot be certified as byte-identical code for every old run.

reward_versions.status: explicit metadata in 11 fresh SAC/D1 runs; strong monitor corroboration across all 20 runs
reward_versions.formula_supported_by_current_source: r_decision = selected_terminal_reward - 0.01 + 0.02 * (ego_route_distance_now_m - ego_route_distance_previous_m). The progress delta is not clipped in the current wrapper. Progress is omitted for a decision if either distance read is unavailable. There is no lane-change reward term in the six recorded keys or current wrapper.
reward_versions.terminal_precedence_limit: The current SumoSceneEnv resolver makes terminal flags exclusive with collision first, then off-route, success, timeout; the current reward wrapper itself checks exposed flags success-first. Neither is frozen to these older sorted runs. Saved train monitors have zero success+collision, success+max_time, collision+max_time, or off-route episode overlaps in every run, so the saved completed episodes do not reveal a precedence difference.
reward_versions.time_units: The coefficients apply once per environment policy-decision step. All 13 fresh-run argument files record action_repeat=3 and discount=0.99; MST values are nested under requested_raw_steps. Continuation argument files omit action_repeat and discount. The 0.02 progress term is per meter of SUMO vehicle.getDistance delta, not per raw tick or second.
reward_versions.timeout_protocol: The sorted scenario protocol/current environment uses a 600 raw SUMO tick cap at 0.1 second per tick (60 seconds). Current SumoEnv exposes a SUMO max-time episode as truncation; the wrapper still adds timeout_reward when info.max_time selects that branch. Exact historical timeout and replay-bootstrap behavior is not frozen by these result files.
reward_versions.evaluation_return_is_separate: Research records define final evaluation mean_return from raw undiscounted outcome info: +1 success, -1 collision, 0 timeout/off-route. It is not the training shaped return or Monitor r.

reward_versions.status: two fresh MST argument files omit reward_shaping; current shared yield_v2 runner and fresh 100k monitor branches support the same six-term scheme, but old source is not frozen

all seven continuation argument/continuation records omit reward weights, action_repeat, and discount. No monitor evidence indicates an obvious reward-scale change; exact equality of continued-stage implementation is not independently proven.

wrapper_formula_and_precedence.notes: Defaults are the six listed values; terminal if/elif; adds -step_cost and un-clipped distance delta; updates per-episode branch totals.

shared_base_config_and_factory.notes: Current base runner uses action_repeat=3, discount=.99, one REWARD object and wraps all base methods, including MST/SAC, with the generalized wrapper. Monitor is outside the shaped environment and in the current source records reward branches.

D1_delegation_and_metadata.notes: Current D1 runner delegates environment creation and reward configuration to the base runner, and records base.REWARD in arguments.

current_raw_outcome_evaluation_note.notes: Current evaluation explicitly accumulates info.undiscounted_reward as raw success/collision outcome.

current_sorted_timeout_cap.notes: Current intersection_sorted scenario spec has 600 raw steps; the current SUMO env describes its cap as raw 0.1-second simulator steps at envs/sumo/sumo_env.py:379.

monitor_evidence.meaning: train_monitor.csv r is the accumulated reward returned to the training Monitor. In current runner code the Monitor wraps the reward-shaped env. Historical headers/branches vary, so old r values are corroboration rather than a frozen-source proof.

current_environment_terminal_resolver.note: This is the current resolver behavior. These 20 local histories predate or lack a matching immutable source snapshot, so this order is not asserted as the historical training order.

current_timeout_truncation.note: Current SUMO max_time is truncated unless success/collision/off-route terminated the episode; wrapper reward still reads info.max_time. Historical replay treatment is not certified by the local run metadata.

monitor_evidence.per_run_outcome_conditioned_monitor_r: Each per_run entry gives [mean r on success, mean r on collision, mean r on max_time] in that run's train_monitor.csv. Values near +12, -9, and -5.6 are consistent with terminal ±10/-5 plus step and progress terms; cohort composition and episode length affect these averages.
monitor_evidence.flag_overlaps: Across all 20 training Monitor files, zero completed episodes have success+collision, success+max_time, collision+max_time, or off_route. This does not reveal what the old reward wrapper would have done for an unobserved dual-flag transition.
